authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W01 accepted + W02 accepted where identity/policy boundaries apply
defaults.mission: Postgres, migrations, outbox/inbox, idempotency, Event Bus/subscriptions, ordering/replay/DLQ, timers/leases/durable workflow.

tasks.title: W03-00 Coordination / Ownership / Risk Freeze
actions: 1. Create W03 charter, dependency matrix, ownership matrix and acceptance/reality gate.
2. Audit existing persistence/event/workflow scaffolds and migrations.
3. Freeze namespaces, canonical EventEnvelope use, migration ownership and internal DAG.
4. Define event-driven-by-default rule and justified polling fallback.
5. Define risk register/pre-mortem/stress plan including duplicate/replay/out-of-order and database failure.
tasks.ownership: W03 governance + coordinator-owned shared persistence/event surfaces
tasks.forbidden: No feature code before W02 release.

tasks.title: W03-A Postgres Schema / Migration Baseline
actions: 1. Define Postgres baseline and migration conventions.
2. Create durable tables/types needed by W03 only, reusing canonical IDs/versioning.
3. Define constraints/indexes/foreign keys/retention that support idempotency, events, timers and leases.
4. Ensure migrations are deterministic, ordered, rollback/forward-safe as architecture supports.
5. Use TOCA migrations only as schema pattern references.
tasks.forbidden: No W04 capability/control schema; no provider/device domain tables.

tasks.title: W03-B Transactional Outbox / Inbox / Idempotency Ledger
actions: 1. Implement transactional outbox enqueue/claim/attempt semantics.
2. Implement inbox/consumer receipt/idempotency ledger.
3. Support duplicate detection, conflict handling and safe claim ownership.
4. Prove repeated delivery/replay does not duplicate downstream side effects.
5. Expose deterministic evidence/correlation hooks.
tasks.ownership: packages/events/src/delivery/** plus W03-B-prefixed event tests; shared @aurora/events package/publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No provider execution; no blind retry semantics; no packages/events manifest, root barrel or transport/subscription leaf edits.

tasks.title: W03-C Event Bus / Subscription Registry
actions: 1. Implement durable EventEnvelope transport abstraction and subscription registry.
2. Support subscriber interest by event/capability metadata without creating W04 capability registry.
3. Support fan-out/fan-in, ack semantics and bounded delivery.
4. Define transport-independent contracts and local/test transport if needed.
5. Replace polling only where reliable events exist; document fallback.
tasks.ownership: packages/events/src/transport/** plus W03-C-prefixed event tests; shared @aurora/events package/publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: Legacy in-memory AuroraEventBus is test/reference only, never production backbone; no packages/events manifest, root barrel or delivery/idempotency leaf edits.

tasks.title: W03-D Ordering / Replay / DLQ
actions: 1. Define explicit ordering semantics only where required.
2. Implement replay controls, offsets/checkpoints or equivalent.
3. Implement DLQ/quarantine/recovery flow.
4. Handle duplicate, replayed and out-of-order EventEnvelope deterministically.
5. Add replay safety invariants for future provider/device side effects.
tasks.ownership: packages/events/src/replay/** plus W03-D-prefixed event tests; shared package/publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: Replay may not grant authority or blindly repeat uncertain side effects; no packages/events manifest or root barrel edits.

tasks.title: W03-E Timers / Leases / Durable Workflow
actions: 1. Implement durable timers and scheduling primitives.
2. Implement lease/claim/heartbeat/expiry/reclaim semantics for durable workers.
3. Implement durable workflow/follow-up primitives and cancellation/timeouts.
4. Support reconnect/offline command workflows for future Device Plane without implementing device runtime.
5. Provide deterministic recovery after process restart.
tasks.forbidden: No W05 agent runtime; no W15 Android runtime.

tasks.title: W03-F Event-Driven Integration / Failure / Load Validation
actions: 1. Integrate schema, outbox/inbox, bus, replay/DLQ and timers/leases.
2. Prove EventEnvelope -> durable delivery -> subscriber -> ack/replay without duplicate side effect.
3. Inject DB outage, worker crash, duplicate delivery, replay, out-of-order, timeout, cancellation and backlog pressure.
4. Measure queue/claim throughput and bounded concurrency.
5. Produce W03 Reality Gate evidence and migration/recovery runbook.
